tools.name: translate.text
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a short text translated between English and one of Twi, Ewe or Ga, three languages of Ghana: a greeting, a sign, a message to a relative, a line for a card. tools.name: translate.languages
tools.description: Use this when you need to know which languages and how much text the Ghana translation tool handles before calling it. Do not use it to translate: use translate.text for that.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "translate.text" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "translate.languages" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
